summary: Refactored Gizmo's workspace inspector to remove extension ownership of WorkspaceView: eliminated the `createView` extension hook, the `createWorkspaceView` helper, and the `'unity'` context kind. Extensions now contribute `dialog`/`settings` components and `inspectorTabs` directly; the inspector renders only those extension tabs. Renamed `showUnityInspector` setting to `showInspector` with a legacy migration.
decisions: Removed `WorkspaceView` interface, `createWorkspaceView` factory, and `workspace-view.ts`; workspace inspector now iterates `webExtensions[*].inspectorTabs` instead of being driven by a domain-owned view
Removed `createView` extension field from `load-web-extension.ts` keep list and from `WebExtensionDefinition` semantics; extensions expose `dialog` and `settings` components instead
Dropped `'unity'` from `ContextKind` in `context-target.ts` and removed `canOpenEditor`/`onOpenEditor`/`onRefreshEditor` props from `AppContextMenu.svelte`
Extracted `workspaceNameFromPath` helper into new `apps/app/src/lib/extensions/workspace-label.ts` so shell code no longer depends on the deleted workspace-view module
Renamed persisted setting `showUnityInspector` → `showInspector` in `app-settings.ts` and `workspace.svelte.ts`, with backward-compatible legacy load that maps the old key to the new one
